title: One press hands a demo site to its business owner through the Team, role, demo clock and address doors, each step reported
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The first press answers team_invite done INVITED (POST /api/team/invite with role editor and the caller's cookie), owner_role skipped INVITE_PENDING, keep_demo done KEPT (demo_expires_at null, never clocked again), domain skipped NOT_ASKED.

Pressed again after the owner accepted: no second invitation, owner_role done PROMOTED (PATCH role owner), keep_demo skipped ALREADY_KEPT, domain done DNS_PENDING; complete true. A third press only skips.
A refused invitation answers 207 with team_invite failed and the later steps skipped; the demo keeps its clock.
An address door that is switched off answers domain not_available OWN_DOMAIN_DISABLED.
Another account's build answers 404; a bad email, an unknown field, the caller's own email, a frozen, deleted or unbuilt demo and the switch off are refused before any door is asked.

tests: the first press invites the owner, keeps the demo for good and waits for them to accept before Owner
pressed again once the owner accepted: no second letter, Owner role, the domain connected
a failed step is reported (207) and nothing that depends on it runs: the demo keeps its clock
a deployment that cannot connect a domain answers that step not_available, never a made-up success
only the build’s own account, a live demo, and a well-formed body
keepDemo: kept once, already kept after, gone for a deleted demo; a frozen demo is thawed
